_note: Every image the site uses, by id. Components never reference /public paths directly. To swap the logo, replace the file in public/brand/ (or change 'src' here) — one line. Illustrations are placeholders generated by `npm run brand` in brand.json colours; replace with real photos by changing src/width/height/alt and status.
